title: GoldenSet
description: v2.0 anti-inflation calibration: a small, human-verified set of jobs with known-correct eval scores, used to detect scorer drift between runs/agents/models. `expected` values must be reviewed and signed off by the candidate, not copied from an agent's own output — copying an agent's output produces a mirror of one run, not a ruler. See careeros/cli/calibrate.py and .careeros/golden/.

version.description: Golden set schema/content version. Bump when entries are added/removed/rotated.

profile_version.description: profile.yaml's version this set was labelled against. A profile bump makes the set STALE (not wrong) — it must be re-labelled, never auto-migrated.

prompt_version.description: The eval prompt version (e.g. 'v2') this set was labelled against. Same staleness rule as profile_version.

sealed_at.description: Date (YYYY-MM-DD) the set was last human-reviewed and signed off.

sealed_by.description: Always 'human' — enforced by convention, not just this schema. An agent must never write this file.

job_hash.description: Job.content_hash() — links this entry to its frozen Job record in jobs.json.

label.description: Human-readable 'Company — Title', for audit output only.

holdout.description: True = never included in a --probe sample; reserved for manual audit only, so memorization of the probed subset can't fully game the set.

note.description: Why this entry is in the set — usually the specific failure mode it anchors (e.g. 'over-senior Principal PM', 'Indian pharma brand-management PM').
